title: CTRL-ALT-CLOUD: Rebooting a 20-Year Career
snippet: In the Windows world, when the system freezes or slows down, you have one universal reflex: Ctrl + Alt + Del. After 20 years in .NET, I realized I needed a hard reboot.

title: Enter the Terraform-asaurus Rex: Taming Infrastructure as Code
snippet: To prove I’m ready for enterprise-scale cloud computing, I had to leave the petting zoo and learn Infrastructure as Code. Enter the Terraform-asaurus Rex.

title: The Automated Dino Feeder: CI/CD Pipeline
snippet: In the DevOps world, manual deployments are called 'toil.' In my head, I call it 'hand-feeding the dinosaur.' Sure, it works. But eventually, you’re going to slip...

title: The Great Meso-DiMarC-zoic Migration
snippet: For years, my business lived in the 'Tar Pits' of legacy hosting. Then the hackers came. Here is how I airlifted DiMarC to the Google Cloud sanctuary.

title: The Global Stampede Diverter: Three Expensive Lessons
snippet: I tried to outsmart the dinosaurs with a cheap masking trick. They crashed right through it. Here is the story of how I ended up building three Load Balancers to control the traffic.

title: The Veloci-error13-raptor: Ambushed by "Clever Girls"
snippet: I thought the Terraform T-Rex was the only danger. I was wrong. In the deep jungle of the Cloud Resume Challenge, I was ambushed by a silent, invisible killer.

title: The Field Guide: Charting the Uncharted with Vanilla JS
snippet: My artifacts were scattered and my future expeditions into AI needed a map. Instead of building a heavy fortress, I opted for a lightweight expedition log. Here is how I mapped the cloud using JSON.

title: Escaping the Tar Pits: The Airlift of 'Amaze & Wonder'
snippet: Legacy hosting is a swamp. To save a client's site, I had to airlift a complex React app out of the WordPress mud and into the sanctuary of Firebase. Here is the rescue log.

title: 20,000 Booking Leads Under the Sea: The Naut-AI-lus Pivot
snippet: Having successfully rescued the Amaze and Wonder flagship, my spyglass immediately caught sight of a new frontier: engineering an end-to-end, serverless event management vessel.

title: Traveling Light-er: Escaping the Infinite Scroll
